The '''Sakuub system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Pelgrin sector/Legends|Pelgrin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakuub]].
